proof_body:
by
  intro f a u hf
  have h1 := hf.tendsto_slope_zero
  have hneg : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => -h) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) := by
    refine tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => -h) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using (continuous_neg (G := ℝ)).tendsto 0
      exact h2.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with h hh
      simpa using hh
  have h3 := (h1.add (h1.comp hneg)).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have e : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (u + u) = u := by ring
  rw [e] at h3
  refine h3.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with h hh
  have hh' : h ≠ 0 := hh
  simp only [Function.comp, smul_eq_mul, sub_eq_add_neg a h]
  field_simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a u : ℝ), HasDerivAt f u a → Filter.Tendsto (fun h => (f (a + h) - f (a - h)) / (2 * h)) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds u)
